text: Ready: you can SSH into spirit-3 now. Your node is restarted on the new code (appFaceApp mounted). The full runbook is bash/FACE.md; here are the exact commands. (1) On spirit-3, as root: git clone https://github.com/andyflinn/SpiritOS.git /root/face/SpiritOS && /root/face/SpiritOS/bash/face-install MCowBQYDK2VwAyEAgrEcBu0FkTzmGKs+oBS+OllzvZh+d/0Rr6fO/fXD+0c= (that's your node's key). Its last lines print THE FACE NODE'S KEY; copy it. (2) Only if it stops at 'no global on_demand_tls block': put the block it prints at the very top of /etc/caddy/Caddyfile, then caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile && systemctl reload caddy && /root/face/SpiritOS/bash/face-tls. (3) Here on your Windows box, in D:\SpiritOS: node bash/face-owner.js <FACE_NODE_KEY>. (4) Test from anywhere: curl -sS https://join.face.spirit.andyflinn.com/, or open it in the browser. Expected: 501 last-leg-not-built, with your key. Paste me whatever it says.
